summary: Iteration 17 - Complete testing of Financial Summary feature for completed demands. All 6 backend tests passed. All 3 frontend UI tests passed. E2E completion flow verified.
seed_data_creation: E2E test demand created: 620bccb5-2b12-4f77-b96b-56202645d27a (standard completion with agreed_price=7500)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Financial Summary feature fully tested and working. Three completion types verified: 1) price_increase (demand a2d8e3b0-388d-4cd0-ac76-b4a8cd2a4d55 with agreed=20000, increase=5000, final=25000), 2) blacklist (demand a26298e5-222b-4bab-b63c-4eddcb74150f with agreed=15000, final=15000, reason='Zákazník byl nepříjemný'), 3) standard (E2E test demand 620bccb5-2b12-4f77-b96b-56202645d27a with agreed=7500, final=7500). Frontend correctly shows 'FINANČNÍ PŘEHLED' section with Dohodnutá cena, Navýšení ceny (only for price_increase), Konečná cena (only when different from agreed), and blacklist warning with reason (only for blacklist type).

BACKEND_API_PRICE_INCREASE_DEMAND.details: GET /api/demands/a2d8e3b0-388d-4cd0-ac76-b4a8cd2a4d55 returns agreed_price=20000, final_price=25000, price_increase=5000, completion_type=price_increase

BACKEND_API_BLACKLIST_DEMAND.details: GET /api/demands/a26298e5-222b-4bab-b63c-4eddcb74150f returns agreed_price=15000, final_price=15000, completion_type=blacklist, blacklist_reason='Zákazník byl nepříjemný a odmítal spolupráci.'

FRONTEND_PRICE_INCREASE_DISPLAY.details: Demand detail page shows 'FINANČNÍ PŘEHLED' with Dohodnutá cena 20 000 Kč, Navýšení ceny +5 000 Kč (orange), Konečná cena 25 000 Kč

FRONTEND_BLACKLIST_DISPLAY.details: Demand detail page shows 'FINANČNÍ PŘEHLED' with Dohodnutá cena 15 000 Kč, red warning 'Zákazník označen — příště neposkytovat' with reason text

E2E_COMPLETION_FLOW.details: Created demand as customer, accepted as supplier, completed with 'standard' type and agreed_price=7500. Financial summary displays correctly on detail page.

DEMAND_WITHOUT_AGREED_PRICE.details: Verified that demands without agreed_price (old demands) return null/0 for financial fields. Frontend correctly hides financial summary when agreed_price is 0 or null.
